title: fix(scenarios): a thrown live turn is recorded and replays as the same failure; a wrongly cased skill file is refused
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQ3DFv6XZAspQRYGQoEWhr8)_

Fixes #34878

Clause-②: yes (widening: published @objectstack/scenarios ./runner types ThrownTurn, RecordedTurn and RecordedThrowError, plus one optional field on Recording.turns)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:场景卡评测的录制回放与 `--ask-skills` 读取各修一处。一是录制时如果一次提问抛了异常，现在会把它记成一个失败的回合，回放时原样再抛一次。二是技能文件名必须正好是 `SKILL.md`,大小写不对就直接拒绝，并说出找到的文件名。
- **为什么改**:以前抛异常的回合什么也不记，回放时这一步成了"未测量",数据集问题那一行就会从现场的 4/5 变成回放的 4/4,分数虚高。大小写不对的 `skill.md` 在 macOS 上会让运行崩溃(TypeError),在 Linux 上又被悄悄跳过。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低，只动评测工具，不碰平台运行时。以前录的录制文件里没有失败标记，回放和原来完全一样，有测试钉住。回滚就是撤掉这个 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts`(`RecordingDriver` 的 try/catch,以及 `RecordedDriver.ask` 和 `author` 开头的重新抛出)、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/ask-skills.ts`(`skillFileOf` 和拒绝的那句话)、`packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts` 文件末尾新加的 describe。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts test/runner/ask-skills.test.ts`,预期 157 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Half 1: a thrown live turn is recorded and replays as the same failure** (`src/runner/driver.ts`)

- `RecordingDriver.ask` and `RecordingDriver.author` (driver.ts:826-856) catch a throw from the live driver. They record the step as an empty turn carrying `thrown: { name, message }`, then rethrow the original error object unchanged. The new optional field lives on `RecordedTurn extends ParsedTurn` (driver.ts:522-535), and `Recording.turns` is typed by it. `ParsedTurn` itself is untouched. A non-`Error` throw records `name: 'Error'` and `String(e)`.
- `RecordedDriver.ask` and `RecordedDriver.author` (driver.ts:752, :768) throw `RecordedThrowError` (driver.ts:573) when a turn carries `thrown`. The error has the recorded `name` and `message`. Nothing is re-sent, and no recorded file is written.
- A throw that is itself a replay's verdict (`MissingRecordingError`, `ReplayNotFaithfulError`, when a replay is being recorded) is left unrecorded, as before (driver.ts:588). Recording it as a plain throw would turn a live "not measured" into an error on the next replay.
- A recording made before this change has no `thrown` turns and replays exactly as it did.

**How the runner counts a live throw and a missing turn.** These sites decided the replay behaviour. All of them are in `orchestrate.ts`, which this PR does not edit:

| Turn | Live throw | Missing turn on replay (before) | Scorer |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| question | `res.error = errText(e)` (orchestrate.ts:1536-1540) | same branch, text `no recorded turn for …` | counted, fails (scorecard.ts:332, :340-341) |
| dataset question | `res.error` (orchestrate.ts:1557-1561) | `MissingRecordingError` ⇒ `notMeasured` (:1558) | measured = `!notMeasured` (scorecard.ts:347-355): **4/5 → 4/4** |
| operation | rethrown (:1606-1607) ⇒ `res.error` (:1697-1698) | same path, other text | scorecard.ts:405-411 |
| confirmation turn | rethrown (:1684) ⇒ `confirmed.error` (:1692-1693) | `MissingRecordingError` ⇒ `notMeasured` (:1679) | scorecard.ts:391-395, :427-431 |
| authoring | `half.error` + `half.notMeasured` with the message (:1042-1052) | same, other text | build not measured |

`errText` (orchestrate.ts:586) reads only `e.message`. A replay that throws an error with the recorded message, and that is neither `MissingRecordingError` nor `ReplayNotFaithfulError`, therefore takes the live branch at every site and gives the identical row, the identical `error` string included. That is why replay rethrows rather than returning a failed turn. A returned turn would be graded, and the grade would differ from the live `error`.

**Half 2: a wrongly cased skill file is refused clearly** (`src/runner/ask-skills.ts`)

- `skillFileOf` (ask-skills.ts:159) reads the directory listing. It answers `SKILL.md`, or the name of a file spelled in some other case of `skill.md`, or nothing. `existsSync(join(dir, 'SKILL.md'))` is gone from the skill test, so the answer is the same on every filesystem.
- `readAskSkills` refuses such a directory before any turn runs. This applies to a top-level skill and to one skill among a directory of skills (ask-skills.ts:181-200). The refusal uses the existing `--ask-skills names …` style: ``--ask-skills names `DIR`, which holds `mixed/Skill.md`: a skill file is spelled `SKILL.md` exactly, or a session reads it on one filesystem and misses it on another; rename it to `SKILL.md` ``.
- Before this change: on a case-insensitive filesystem, `f.get('SKILL.md')!` was `undefined` and the read threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toString')`. On a case-sensitive filesystem, a top-level `skill.md` answered "holds no skill", and a misspelt skill among others was skipped without a word.

## Tests

All new tests are in existing harness files, as top-level `describe` blocks.

- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, at the end of the file, `runHalf — a live turn that throws is recorded as a failed turn, and its replay counts the row it counted live`:
  - A live ask-mode run whose dataset question `dq_staff`, question `tech_accounts` and operation `add_contact` throw. The recording holds each step as `{ replyText: '', toolCalls: [], meta: {}, thrown }`. Replaying it gives the same `datasetTally` (1/2, never 1/1), the same question and dataset-question results (`error`, `notMeasured`, `grade`) and the same operation `error`. This is the card's Done-when.
  - Control: the same recording with the thrown steps' keys removed, which is what a run before this change wrote. It replays as today: `dq_staff` not measured (1/1 · 1 not measured), and `tech_accounts` erroring `no recorded turn for …`.
  - Driver level: the live error object is rethrown as is (`rejects.toBe`). The replay's error has the same `name` and `message` and is not `ReplayNotFaithfulError`. A replayed authoring turn writes no file. A recording of the replay holds the same turns.
  - A thrown authoring turn replays to the same build half (`error: 'author: spawn claude ENOENT'`, same `notMeasured`).
- `test/runner/ask-skills.test.ts`, `readAskSkills — a skill file is matched by its exact spelling, on every filesystem`. A hoisted `vi.mock('node:fs')` stands in for a case-insensitive filesystem on any host: when switched on, `existsSync` answers true for any casing. Each case runs with it on and off.
  - A top-level `skill.md` gets the full refusal sentence.
  - `mixed/Skill.md` among other skills is refused by its path, not skipped.
  - Control: `SKILL.md` still loads, as a directory of skills and as a single skill.

## Acceptance notes

- **Other `SKILL.md` `existsSync` sites in the package, not changed (listed as the card asked):**
  - `src/runner/packages.ts:332` (`skillDirs`): it compares the workspace catalog with the project's synced copy by real file names. It reads no file through the `SKILL.md` spelling, so there is no TypeError. A wrongly cased catalog skill would be counted on a case-insensitive host and skipped on a case-sensitive one, on both sides alike, so the copy check still holds. The catalog is the published `skills/` tree, which has its own gates.
  - `src/skill-evals/cases.ts:145`: on a case-insensitive host it reads `join(root, b, 'SKILL.md')` successfully (no TypeError). On a case-sensitive host a wrongly cased bundle is skipped silently, so its evals are not loaded. The root is the same published catalog. Fixing it would be outside this claim's file surface.
- `thrownTurn` leaves `ReplayNotFaithfulError` unrecorded, as today, when a replay is itself recorded. A recording of a replay therefore still meets a gap at that step. This is unchanged behaviour, and only a replay of a replay hits it.
- `Recording.turns` now maps each step key to a `RecordedTurn`, a subtype of `ParsedTurn`. Readers typed `ParsedTurn` (`export/transcript.ts` `mergeRecordings`) compile unchanged. The export path looks a turn up only for a question with a grade, which a thrown turn never has.

## Verification

All readings are at head `3644012a50` unless a line says otherwise.

They touch `packages/spec` and `ui/`, and in this package only `test/dataset-cards.test.ts`. overlap-check reads a clean merge, and PR CI runs on the merge ref.
